title: Skills
intro: Reference material Awak can open while it works. Upload or write skills here, review what the scan found, and enable the ones project admins may assign to roles.

adminOnly.title: Kemudi admins only
adminOnly.body: Only Kemudi admins manage the skill library. Project admins assign enabled skills to roles in the project's Agent settings.
adminOnly.loadError: Couldn't check your access. Try again later.

rules.pipe_to_shell: Pipes a download into a shell

list.emptyHint: Upload a skill as a .zip, or write one in the Create tab.
list.highBlocks: A high scan finding blocks enabling this skill.

detail.enabledHint: Project admins can assign it to roles.
detail.disabledHint: Roles that list it show a warning, and Awak skips it.
detail.deleteBody: Every version of the skill is removed from Kemudi. This can't be undone.
detail.deleteInUse: Remove the skill from these roles first: {{roles}}.
detail.builtinNoDelete: Built-in skills can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
detail.noLicenseWarning: No licence is stated in this skill. Check where it came from before you enable it.
detail.highWarning: The current version has a high scan finding, so it can't be enabled. Upload or write a new version without it.
detail.noFindings: The scan found nothing in this version.
detail.pickFile: Choose a file to view it.
detail.noCurrent: This skill has no active version.

editor.newIntro: Kemudi builds SKILL.md from these fields. A new skill is saved disabled; enable it from the Installed tab.
editor.versionIntro: Saving creates version {{next}}. Roles that use the skill get it on their next run.
editor.keepsBinaries_one: {{count}} binary file from the current version is kept.
editor.keepsBinaries_other: {{count}} binary files from the current version are kept.
editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64 characters. It is also the folder name.
editor.descriptionHint: Say what the skill does and when Awak should use it.
editor.descriptionCut: Awak sees only the first {{max}} characters.
editor.bodyHint: Markdown. Keep it under 500 lines; move detail into extra files.
editor.filesHint: Text files such as reference/style.md. Binary files come in through Upload.
editor.unchanged: Nothing changed, so no new version was made.

check.title: Check
check.error: The check couldn't run. Saving checks again.
check.empty: Fill in a name and a description to check the skill.

upload.title: Upload a skill
upload.intro: A .zip or .skill archive with one skill folder, or a single SKILL.md. It is checked and scanned before it's stored, and saved disabled.
upload.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
upload.exists: A local skill named {{slug}} already exists (version {{version}}).
upload.notLocal: {{slug}} is a built-in or marketplace skill. Rename the skill folder and its name in SKILL.md, then upload again.
upload.unchanged: {{slug}} already has these exact files; nothing changed.
upload.disabledNow: The new version has a high scan finding, so the skill was disabled.
upload.stillDisabled: Review it, then enable it from the list.
upload.findings_one: The scan found {{count}} thing to review.
upload.findings_other: The scan found {{count}} things to review.
